llm.summary: This skill gives presentation-building guidance and does not show hidden data access, persistence, or unsafe execution behavior.

dimensions.detail: Creating local presentation files is proportionate to the stated purpose; the skill explicitly avoids external CDN links and does not request credentials, broad filesystem indexing, or network access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no executable installer, bundled scripts, dependencies, or remote payload retrieval.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger description is somewhat broad, but the runtime instructions are presentation-specific and require structured dialogue plus user confirmation before building slides.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background workers, memory writes, session/profile access, or tool hijacking behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact coherently describes a skill for brainstorming and building HTML presentation materials with local HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and optional media assets.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want an agent to help plan and generate HTML slide decks. Review where it writes presentation files in your project, and be aware that its broad trigger wording may activate for general talk or sharing requests.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger wording could cause occasional over-selection for presentation-adjacent requests, but the artifact-backed behavior remains limited to user-directed HTML presentation creation and is not a material security concern.
[AIG-SARIF] expected: The supplied static scan reported no results, and inspection found no shell execution, credential handling, remote retrieval, persistence, or destructive instructions.
